summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The First Trust Dow Jones Select MicroCap Index Fund (FDM) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the DJ Select Micro-Cap index. The fund tracks an index of U.S.-listed stocks in the bottom two market-cap deciles. Only stocks that meet fundamental and liquidity thresholds are included in the index. FDM was launched on Sep 27, 2005 and is issued by First Trust.

holdings.infoBox: FDM is an equity ETF with a total of 137 individual holdings. The top holdings are PagerDuty stock at 1.85%, Rigel Pharmaceuticals at 1.53%, Orrstown Financial Services at 1.35%, Seneca Foods at 1.34%, and Standard Motor Products at 1.33%.
